dashboard.welcomeSubtitle: Tell us about the occasion — a birthday, wedding, anniversary or anything else — and we will create invitations, greetings and announcements for you.
dashboard.step1Desc: What is being celebrated, who it is for and when — two sentences will do.
dashboard.step2Desc: Video, images and text — you see and approve everything before it goes out.
dashboard.step3Desc: Share straight to Facebook and Instagram from {name}, or download and send it yourself.
dashboard.deleteConfirm: Delete this occasion? The films made for it disappear too.

register.subtitle: Create invitations, greetings and announcements in minutes.
register.title: Create an account

productModal.title: New occasion
productModal.productNamePlaceholder: e.g. “Oktoberfest in Kari and Ola’s garden”
productModal.descriptionPlaceholder: Who it is for, when and where it happens, and the mood you want …
productModal.descriptionHint: Used when the invitations and greetings are created — two sentences will do.
productModal.errorNameRequired: Tell us what is being celebrated.

newDraft.title: Create a video for the occasion
newDraft.subtitle: We filled in what you already told us about the occasion — edit freely before the video is made.
newDraft.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Crayfish party on our street
newDraft.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Everyone on the street is invited to a crayfish party in the garden on Saturday at 6 pm. Bring your own drinks.
newDraft.targetAudiencePlaceholder: e.g. The neighbours, family and friends
newDraft.problemLabel: The most important things to include
newDraft.problemPlaceholder: e.g. Time, place, and that people bring their own drinks
newDraft.ctaPlaceholder: e.g. Let us know by Thursday if you are coming!

videoStatus.title: Your film is being made
videoStatus.takesTime: This usually takes a few minutes. You can close the page and come back — the film will be waiting under the occasion.
